combo1.title: 1-Card Foolish Burial (1 Discard) — Liger Dancer & I:P
combo1.description: A core 1-card starter line opening with Foolish Burial and 1 discard cost. Sends Lunalight Yellow Marten to search Lunalight Masquerade, triggering Silver Hound in the Graveyard to summon Gold Leo and Kaleido Chick. Summons Lunalight Perfume Dancer to search Luna Light Perfume, links into Cross-Sheep, and overlays Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King to search Fire Formation - Tenki. Places Lunalight Wolf in the Pendulum Scale to Miracle Fusion summon the untargetable Lunalight Liger Dancer alongside I:P Masquerena for disruption.

combo2.title: 1-Card Foolish Burial (2 Discards) — Nibiru Recovery & M7 Pivot
combo2.description: An advanced resilience line testing full board recovery after an immediate Nibiru, the Primal Being wipe on Summon 5. Recovers through Graveyard synergy using Luna Light Perfume and Lunalight Tiger's Pendulum revival loops to overlay into Constellar Ptolemy M7, retrieving key resources to climb back into Cross-Sheep and conclude with Lunalight Liger Dancer.

combo3.title: 1-Card Foolish Burial (2 Discards) — Liger Dancer, Bagooska & I:P
combo3.description: A high-ceiling variant of the Foolish Burial starter line requiring two discard costs. Sequences through Yellow Marten, Masquerade, and Silver Hound into Kaleido Chick and Perfume Dancer. Converts surplus Level 4 bodies into Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir and I:P Masquerena for defensive lockdown, while Lunalight Wolf fuses banished materials into Lunalight Liger Dancer.

combo4.title: 1-Card Gold Leo (0 Discards) — Pure Liger Dancer & I:P
combo4.description: A hyper-efficient zero-discard starter route opening purely with Normal Summoning Lunalight Gold Leo without requiring any discards. Gold Leo searches and discards Lunalight Silver Hound to Special Summon Kaleido Chick directly from Deck. The sequence navigates through Perfume Dancer, Cross-Sheep, and Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King to place Lunalight Wolf in the Pendulum Scale, crowning the board with Lunalight Liger Dancer protected by I:P Masquerena without sacrificing additional card economy.
